figurative_meaning_en: The elder or senior branch of the family lineage
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে বড় তরফের সদস্য, তাই পরিবারের সিদ্ধান্তে তার কথা বেশি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।
বড় তরফের লোকেরা সম্পত্তির বড় অংশ পায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is from the elder branch, so his opinion carries more weight in family decisions.
Members of the senior line receive the larger share of the property.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali joint family structures where seniority determines inheritance and authority.
